decisions.decision: Option B layout (ranked table + expandable rows)
decisions.rationale: User wants to scan fast and drill into candidates that stand out

decisions.decision: KPI placement: mini strip on Bull page (collapsed) + full detail in Progress (collapsed)
decisions.rationale: User does not want stats distracting from primary workflow

decisions.decision: Deterministic scoring (0-100) replaces Claude Haiku batch scoring
decisions.rationale: Score compression from Haiku + missing IV data makes scores meaningless; code is more reliable and explainable

decisions.decision: OptionsProvider abstraction: YFinanceOptionsProvider for POC, TradierOptionsProvider stub ready
decisions.rationale: User willing to pay for data after POC value demonstrated; one env var swap

decisions.decision: S&P 500 universe for technical stage, top 20 survivors for per-ticker options check
decisions.rationale: User wants large discovery universe, not curated 75-stock list

decisions.decision: Auto-log paper trades for score >= 60 + complete data quality on every scan
decisions.rationale: Empirical validation requires self-logging without user action

decisions.decision: Sprint 2 ML (logistic regression) triggers after 50+ resolved paper trades
decisions.rationale: Cannot train on imaginary data; collect first, train second

decisions.decision: Channel proximity: stock must be in bottom 25% of channel (proximity_pct <= 0.25)
decisions.rationale: User specifically looks for stocks near bottom of upward channel (support test setup)

decisions.decision: RSI slope (direction) prioritized over RSI value
decisions.rationale: User said direction matters more than absolute value

decisions.decision: ATM or ITM short put, 5-7 DTE weekly expiry
decisions.rationale: User's style: aggressive credit, capitalize in first week, high-frequency small wins
